meta.name: Grit Xtra
meta.description:
Grit Xtra is home to your favorite legendary action heroes. With timeless programming and characters like Clint Eastwood and John Wayne, Grit Xtra showcases classic all-American storytelling through iconic Western movies and series.

Shows: The Shadow Riders, Last Stand at Saber River, Monte Walsh
Available on: Samsung TV Plus, iptv-org
